title: Senior SAP Integration Architect
jobDescription:
Define and own the end-to-end integration architecture and target landscape using SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration, API Management and Advanced Event Mesh, as well as SAP PO. (25%) • Establish integration standards, reusable patterns, naming conventions and governance to ensure consistency, quality, security and scalability across projects. (20%) • Evaluate, compare and select suitable integration technologies for each use case, considering SAP and non-SAP tools, requirements, cost and total cost of ownership. (15%) • Design event-driven integration architectures with SAP Advanced Event Mesh, including event topologies, messaging patterns and eventing standards. (15%) • Design secure and scalable API strategies with SAP API Management, covering security, versioning, lifecycle governance, reusability and readiness for AI and agent-based integration scenarios. (15%) We offer: Qualifications/Specialization: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. Preferred: experience with SAP S/4HANA integration technologies and clean-core principles, cloud platforms such as SAP BTP or Azure, microservices and event-driven architecture, AI/Gen AI and agentic concepts such as Model Context Protocol, SAP AI Core or Joule, and relevant SAP Integration Suite or SAP BTP architecture certifications. Tasks and

8+ years of hands-on integration experience, including SAP PO and SAP backend integration; 4+ years of experience architecting solutions with SAP Integration Suite, including SAP Cloud Integration, SAP API Management and SAP BTP. title: Sr Professional Application Developer
jobDescription:
requirements and solution design through implementation, cutover and post go live support for an Icertis go-live scheduled October
2026. We offer: Lead architecture and technical roadmap for Icertis, ensuring readiness for Oct 2026 go-live and ongoing production operations. Drive and deliver complex integrations (design, build, test, deploy) between Icertis and enterprise systems including SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), SAP MDG, Microsoft apps (Azure AD, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365), Adobe (Sign/Document workflows) and downstream ERP/Finance systems. Translate business requirements into technical specifications, data/metadata models, API contract definitions, and mapping for contract ingestion and lifecycle processes. Implement integration patterns using middleware/ESB, APIs, message queues or batch ETL as appropriate; own error handling and reconciliation strategies. Design and operate CI/CD pipelines, environment provisioning, containerization/AKS deployments and Ia C (Terraform/ARM/Bicep) for Icertis components and integration services. Define and enforce governance: security, RBAC (Azure AD), data protection, audit trails, and change-control for CLM configuration and integrations. Lead UAT, integration testing, go-live cutover planning and execution; author rollback plans and runbooks; coordinate cutover with SAP, MDG and other app owners. Provide L2/L3 support post-go-live; lead incident response, RCA and long-term remediation to reduce MTTR. Mentor and guide developer/admin teams; review designs and code; establish standards for configuration, customization and documentation. Engage directly with Legal, Procurement, Sales and Supplier/Customer stakeholders to ensure solution meets CLM business processes for both customers and suppliers.
